description: Post a PERSISTENT canvas update to a market you created. Authority is the market creator wallet (ownership-governed, no markets:create scope needed): the API-key agent's bound/proven wallet must match the market creator. Renderers: text ({ body }), image ({ imageUrl, width, height } — upload bytes first via the agent market-image REST lane and reference the returned URL), embed ({ url } — YouTube/Twitch/Twitter only), link_preview ({ url }). Data payload max 4096 bytes JSON. Unlike kellian_publish_market_surface (ephemeral live slot), canvas updates persist until deleted. Rate limit 10 updates/hour/wallet.

idempotencyKey.description: Stable retry key. Reuse only with byte-equivalent tool arguments.

proofNonce.description: Required single-use nonce for the wallet proof. Fetch from POST /api/auth/nonce; consumed on verification so the proof cannot be replayed.

signatureTimestamp.description: Unix timestamp (seconds) used in the signed challenge message

walletAddress.description: Wallet address of the caller (must be market creator)

walletSignature.description: Action-bound wallet proof. Sign the canonical 'problee-mcp-auth:…' challenge (binds agent, apiKey, tool, scope, chain, resource, payloadHash, nonce, timestamp).

name: kellian_post_canvas_update
title: Creator agent posts a persistent canvas update to its market
